source_name: National Bank of Serbia — payment institution licence pages for ME-linked groups (e.g. Alta Pay Group)
why_relevant: Mirror-regulator source. Because several Montenegrin PIs belong to Serbian groups, the NBS payment-institution register carries parallel licence and management data for the parent, allowing cross-border corroboration of group leadership and of which entity actually holds which permissions. Useful for disambiguating same-named entities across ME and RS.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages for Montenegrin payments actors and vendors
why_relevant: Richest single channel for leadership moves and headcount trajectory in a market where PIs employ single-digit to low-double-digit staff: new-hire announcements, title changes and 'we are hiring' posts are often the only public trace. Confirmed pages exist for Payten and PaySpot d.o.o. Novi Sad; ME entity pages should be resolved per actor.

source_name: ICT Cortex — Montenegrin ICT cluster (news / members)
why_relevant: Cluster of ~40 Montenegrin IT companies (founders: Alicorn, Amplitudo, Bild Studio, Codeus, Codingo, Coinis, Data Design, Fleka, Logate, Oykos). Member list is an actor map for the cell; news items announce new members (e.g. fintech startup 'Financial Solutions'), office openings and management changes.

source_name: Naučno-tehnološki park Crne Gore (Science and Technology Park Montenegro)
why_relevant: State-linked incubator hosting startups incl. fintech; publishes tenant cohorts, AIM Innovation Week programmes and the Startup Index of Montenegro (65 startups surveyed) — pointer to companies, founders and teams that never surface in registers.

source_name: Startup Index Crne Gore coverage (DAN — tehnologije)
why_relevant: First comprehensive Montenegrin startup index (NTP + Game Changer Montenegro, 65 startups) — baseline population and headcount/growth signals for fintech-adjacent startups; national daily also runs tech-desk pieces on appointments.

source_name: Fond za inovacije Crne Gore (Innovation Fund) — programme beneficiaries
why_relevant: Publishes grant beneficiaries and mentored early-stage teams; funded fintech teams typically hire immediately after award, so award lists are a leading indicator of hiring and founding-team composition.

source_name: Coinis (Podgorica) — careers and people pages
why_relevant: Largest Podgorica-headquartered adtech/AI scaleup (~78 staff, founder/CEO Anton Jurovicki), ICT Cortex founding member and a bellwether for Montenegrin tech hiring. Its /people and /careers pages expose team composition and open roles directly.

source_name: Joberty — Montenegro IT company profiles and reviews
why_relevant: Regional (RS/ME) IT employer-review and company-profile platform; employee reviews and profile updates reveal headcount changes, team structure and management churn at Montenegrin fintech/IT employers that publish nothing themselves.

source_name: Prekoveze.me — IT job listings
why_relevant: Second major Montenegrin job portal; complementary employer coverage to Zaposli.ME, useful for catching smaller fintech/crypto employers and agency-posted country-manager searches.

source_name: Pazar3.me — business/jobs classifieds
why_relevant: High-traffic Montenegrin classifieds where very small or newly registered crypto/exchange shops post staffing ads that never reach formal job boards — long-tail detection of micro-entrants on the coast.

source_name: Poslovi Infostud — Montenegro listings
why_relevant: Regional Serbian job giant with a Montenegro section; Serbian and regional fintechs expanding into Montenegro frequently post ME roles here rather than on ME-only portals.

source_name: MeetFrank — remote/onsite crypto jobs in Montenegro
why_relevant: Aggregates crypto/web3 roles tied to Montenegro (incl. relocation offers); shows which foreign crypto firms are building or relocating teams into ME — exactly the staffing signal absent from registers.

source_name: Web3.career / Cryptocurrencyjobs.co — crypto job boards with ME relocation roles
why_relevant: Global crypto boards carry 'relocation to Montenegro' postings (e.g. a BeInCrypto blockchain-developer role with ME relocation), revealing foreign crypto employers seeding Montenegrin offices.

source_name: Tracxn — FinTech startups in Montenegro
why_relevant: Enumerates ~102 ME-linked fintech companies with funding status and team/competitor profiles; the most complete ready-made actor map for this cell, feeding downstream people-tracking.

source_name: Dealroom — Montenegro ecosystem profile
why_relevant: Public 'taster' of ME startup ecosystem with founder pedigrees and team maps behind demo access; useful for identifying founders and C-level of ME-active fintechs and their moves between companies.

source_name: StartupBlink — Podgorica / Montenegro ecosystem pages
why_relevant: Free ranked listing of ME/Podgorica startups; low-cost cross-check on which fintech startups are still active and where secondary hubs (Nikšić, Bar) are emerging.

source_name: Wellfound — Montenegro tech companies and jobs
why_relevant: Startup-native hiring platform: ME-located startups list roles, funding and team size; catches early-stage fintech teams before they appear in local media.

source_name: INFINTECH conference (Porto Montenegro) — speakers and delegates
why_relevant: ME-hosted fintech/banking conference gathering 300+ banks, regulators and fintechs; speaker bios and delegate lists are a reliable annual snapshot of who currently holds which C-level/country role in ME-active fintechs.

source_name: Spark.me conference (Porto Montenegro / Digitalizuj.Me)
why_relevant: Flagship ME tech conference; speaker rosters and side-announcements are where founders of ME fintech/crypto ventures publicly present themselves and announce expansions.

source_name: eKapija Montenegro — business/IT news
why_relevant: Regional business wire with a Montenegrin edition; routinely reports appointments, office openings and investments in ME IT/fintech companies in local language.

source_name: Portal Analitika — tech/business section
why_relevant: Montenegrin news portal covering the IT cluster and digital-economy actors; carries interviews with founders/executives that reveal team size, new offices and role changes.

source_name: GoBTC — crypto exchange with Budva office
why_relevant: Concrete example of a coastal crypto operator (Budva plus other ME cities) whose site announces branch presence and services; watching such operators' site/contact pages is the only practical way to detect coastal office openings and staff.

source_name: Infinum Podgorica office page (tech scaleup office-opening template)
why_relevant: Regional scaleup that opened a Podgorica office with a named managing director — the canonical pattern for how office openings and country-lead appointments are disclosed (company office page + local press), and a template for monitoring similar fintech entrants.

source_name: The Org — Montenegro office/people profiles
why_relevant: Crowd/scraped org charts showing who sits in a company's Podgorica office and their titles; one of the few structured sources for country-level leadership of financial-sector organisations in ME.

source_name: The Fintech Times — Montenegro fintech ecosystem coverage
why_relevant: One of very few English trade outlets writing country pieces on ME fintech; useful for naming entrants and executives and for corroborating local-language reports.

source_name: LinkedIn — Montenegrin company pages and people updates (me.linkedin.com)
why_relevant: The single richest venue for founder/C-level announcements, country-manager hires and office-opening posts by ME-active fintechs; company pages and 'new position' updates are the de facto public record for this cell.

source_name: ZZZCG — Obavještenje o promjeni u oglašavanju slobodnih radnih mjesta (publication-rules notice)
why_relevant: Documents how and where vacancies must be advertised — indicates publication in the daily newspaper 'Dan' on Mondays/Wednesdays/Fridays plus the ZZZCG website. Establishes the legal/procedural publication venue chain, i.e. tells a collector which off-web channels also carry vacancies and on what cadence.
